title: Read meta-acceptance rubric keys
description: Return the six current meta-rubric criteria needed for a complete current-revision attestation.
script: const r = await tools.rubrics.get({ rubricRef: 'meta-acceptance-rubric' }); const x = r.results?.[0]?.rubric; return { rubricId: x?.rubricId, criteria: x?.criteria?.map(({ key, title, model, method }) => ({ key, title, model, method })), ratingScale: x?.ratingScale, updatedAt: x?.updatedAt };
